page_title: BAY 0-2 DOR | Bayern Munich v Dortmund 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90+4' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Bayern Munich earn a corner.
90+4' Bayern Munich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+1' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Bayern Munich due to an offside in the build-up play.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' The Bayern Munich players halt their celebrations as referee Harm Osmers makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
89' Goal! Noussair Mazraoui puts the ball on the head of Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who has the easy task to score into an empty net. 1:2.
88' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
84' Karim Adeyemi will be replaced by Marius Wolf (Dortmund).
84' Edin Terzic prepares a substitution. Jadon Sancho is replaced by Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) replaces Alphonso Davies.
83' 0 - 2 Goal! Sebastien Haller tees up Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:2.

82' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Sven Ulreich to get hold of the ball.
80' The resulting free kick from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
80' Harm Osmers blows his whistle and signals a foul after Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) brought his opponent down.
77' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but Sven Ulreich comes off his line to gather the ball.
75' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

75' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Alexander Meyer easily deals with the threat. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich win a corner kick.
74' Edin Terzic has decided to make a change. Sebastien Haller (Dortmund) replaces Niclas Fullkrug.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) is coming onto the pitch as Konrad Laimer cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
72' Shots on target – 2:4.
69' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
69' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
68' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
67' Substitution. Felix Nmecha makes his way off the pitch and Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) comes on as his replacement.
67' Edin Terzic has decided to substitute Julian Brandt and he is replaced by Marco Reus (Dortmund).
67' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is quickest inside the box and jumps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it flies just wide of the right post.
67' Bayern Munich will take a corner kick.
67' A cross into the box from Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) is cleared.
66' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) produces a stunning solo run from the middle of the pitch, all the way to the penalty area. He unleashes a decent strike which goes narrowly wide of the right post.
63' Leroy Sane comes off the pitch to be replaced by Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich).
63' Here is a change. Thomas Muller is going off and Thomas Tuchel gives the last tactical orders to Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich).
63' It's time for a substitution. Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) comes on in place of Jamal Musiala.
61' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
59' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
58' A cross from a corner kick by Dortmund is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
57' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Dortmund force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
54' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
53' The corner kick from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

53' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Sven Ulreich leaps like a salmon to deny him.
51' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ian Maatsen (Dortmund).
50' What a big chance! Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post.
49' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
47' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Harm Osmers blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
45+2' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
41' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Harm Osmers blows for a foul.
40' Total attempts – 9:4.
40' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) serves up a nice cross, but Alexander Meyer punches the ball away.
38' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
36' The Bayern Munich players can’t believe it after referee Harm Osmers signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
36' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Bayern Munich! Let's see what he decides.
36' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
35' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
34' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
34' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Bayern Munich force a corner. They send men into the box.
33' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
31' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
30' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies high over the bar.
30' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alexander Meyer, who smothers the ball.
28' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes a short corner kick.

28' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
27' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Sven Ulreich easily deals with the threat.
26' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

25' Alexander Meyer pulls off a decent save! Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
23' A lofted ball into the centre of the box is met with a forceful header by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
21' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Harm Osmers who sees an offensive foul.
21' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
19' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post.
18' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
18' The resulting corner from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is cleared by the defence.
17' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Dortmund force their opponents to concede a corner.
15' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
15' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
13' A pass from Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is intercepted by Sven Ulreich and the move breaks down.
10' 0 - 1 Goal! Julian Brandt slips a clever pass through to Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
9' The ball is cleared after Julian Brandt (Dortmund) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
7' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
5' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
4' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
4' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
3' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) makes a rough challenge and Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Emre Can (Dortmund) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
2' Bayern Munich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' The first half has just begun.
Dortmund will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Harm Osmers.
